parameters.message: =Case {{$json.case_number}} ({{$json.defendant}}): {{$json.attempt_count}} attempts in {{$json.days_since_first}} days, no personal service. SOL in {{$json.days_to_sol}} days. Approve substitute/alternate service?

parameters.content:
📘 WORKFLOW DETAILS

Process Serving Agency – Attempt Escalation & Affidavit-of-Service Builder

VALUE PROP: Every field attempt logged by a process server is scored against jurisdiction attempt-count rules and the case's statute-of-limitations deadline, routed for attorney sendAndWait approval when alternate service becomes eligible, and closed out with a deterministic affidavit-of-service draft staged into the court's e-filing queue.

WHO / PROBLEM: Process servers log attempts in the field; paralegals have to track attempt counts per case, catch SOL deadlines, and know exactly when a case qualifies for substitute/posted service — a rule that varies and is easy to miss under caseload pressure. A missed SOL deadline can get a case dismissed.

WALKTHROUGH:
1. Field agent submits an attempt via form (case #, address, outcome notes).
2. Case state is pulled and attempt count / SOL countdown are computed (Code).
3. Outcome notes are classified into 5 categories by AI (multi-output, no If/Switch).
4. If alt-service-eligible and not yet authorized, the workflow pauses (Slack send-and-wait) for attorney approval.
5. Case status is finalized, case state is upserted (this run's watchdog state).
6. Closed cases get a template-filled affidavit, saved to Drive and staged in the court e-filing API.
7. Every attempt — closed or not — gets a Slack status update.

NODE SUMMARY: Form Trigger, Data Table (x2), Code (x2), Text Classifier + Chat Model, If (x3), Slack sendAndWait, Set, Google Drive, HTTP Request, Merge (x2), Slack.

EXPECTED I/O: In: one attempt-log form submission per attempt. Out: updated case row, Slack updates, and (on closure) an affidavit file + staged e-filing.

STICKY COLOUR LEGEND: 1 trigger (blue) · 2 transform (grey) · 3 AI (purple) · 4 branch (yellow) · 5 storage (green) · 6 notify (red).

⚙ SETUP GUIDE

1. Import this JSON via n8n → Workflows → Import from File.
2. Create the n8n Data Table "process_serving_cases" with columns: case_number, attempt_count, first_attempt_date, sol_deadline, alt_service_authorized, case_status (used by: Get Case Record, Update Case Record).
3. Create credential "Swapnil AI Labs – OpenAI" (OpenAI API) on: GPT-4o-mini for Outcome Classification.
4. Create credential "Legal Ops – Slack" (Slack API) on: Request Alt-Service Approval, Post Case Status Update.
5. Create credential "Legal Ops – Google Drive" (Google Drive OAuth2) on: Save Affidavit to Drive.
6. Create credential "Court E-Filing API Key" (Header Auth) on: Submit to Court E-Filing API.
7. Replace CASE_AFFIDAVITS_FOLDER_ID with your real Drive folder ID.
8. Set #case-approvals and #case-tracking to your real Slack channels.
9. Adjust the jurisdiction rule (3 attempts / 30 days) in Compute Attempt Count & SOL Countdown to match your state.
10. TEST: submit the form twice for the same fake case number, confirm attempt_count increments and the classifier routes correctly.

EST. SETUP TIME: 35–45 minutes.

STATUS NOTE: Data Table and Slack sendAndWait parameter shapes were built from best-effort knowledge (live docs did not expose exact JSON) — confirm both nodes' fields on first import.

🎨 CUSTOMISATION

1. Compute Attempt Count & SOL Countdown (Code): change the 3-attempts/30-days rule to your jurisdiction's actual substitute-service statute.
2. Classify Attempt Outcome (Text Classifier): add categories like "hostile_dog" or "gated_community" if your servers report those often.
3. Request Alt-Service Approval (Slack): swap to Gmail sendAndWait if your firm's attorneys prefer email approvals.
4. Generate Affidavit of Service Draft (Code): extend the template with your state's exact affidavit boilerplate language.
5. Submit to Court E-Filing API (HTTP Request): point at your real e-filing vendor (Tyler/Odyssey, One Legal, etc.) and map their required fields.

ℹ ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

ERROR HANDLING: External-call nodes (Slack, Google Drive, HTTP Request, OpenAI chat model) use onError=continueRegularOutput with retryOnFail, maxTries=3, waitBetweenTries=2000ms. Data Table, Code, Set, If, Merge and the Form Trigger are excluded — they are local/deterministic, not third-party API calls.

API COST / RATE LIMITS: One classifier call per attempt (cheap, short input); Slack sendAndWait pauses execution indefinitely until answered — set a reminder/escalation policy on the approval message in production.

DATA PRIVACY: Case data includes defendant names and addresses — treat the Data Table and Drive folder as containing PII/legal records; restrict access accordingly.

N8N VERSION BUILT AGAINST: n8n 1.6x (nodes-base ~ Sept 2026), typeVersions as declared per node.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS: Offline hand-authored build, not tested against a live n8n instance. Data Table and Slack sendAndWait parameter shapes should be re-checked against your instance's node UI on first import.

CREATOR: Swapnil AI Labs — swapnil.mandloi7@gmail.com — swapnilailabs.netlify.app

**New Service Attempt Submitted**
Field process server submits one form after every attempt, in-app or via phone.
Required: case #, defendant, address, outcome notes.
This is the only data-entry point for the entire case file.

**Get Case Record**
Looks up this case's running attempt count, SOL deadline and prior status.
Match: case_number.
Without state, the escalation rule (3 attempts/30 days) can't be evaluated.

nodes.name: Note: Compute Attempt Count & SOL Countdown

parameters.content:
**Compute Attempt Count & SOL Countdown**
Increments attempts, computes days-to-statute-of-limitations, applies the 3-attempts/30-days alt-service rule.
Rule: attempt_count>=3 AND <=30 days.
Getting this wrong risks a case being dismissed for defective service.

**GPT-4o-mini for Outcome Classification**
Chat model backing the attempt-outcome classifier.
Model: gpt-4o-mini, temp 0.
Deterministic classification matters more than creativity here.

**Classify Attempt Outcome**
Routes the free-text field note into one of 5 outcome categories (multi-output, no Switch/If used here).
Categories: served / evasion / wrong-address / refused / no-answer.
Field notes are messy prose — this is the only reliable way to route them.

**Is Alt-Service Eligible?**
Branch point 1: only cases past the attempt threshold, not yet authorized, and not already served reach approval.
Condition: alt_service_eligible AND NOT already_authorized AND category != served.
Most attempts just log and wait — this keeps the attorney's queue small.

**Request Alt-Service Approval**
Pauses the workflow (send-and-wait) until the supervising attorney approves or denies alternate service.
Channel: #case-approvals.
A paralegal cannot authorize substitute/posted service — only the attorney of record can.

**Was It Approved?**
Branch point 2: reads the attorney's Slack approval response.
Condition: data.approved == true.
Denied requests loop back to standard attempts instead of escalating service method.

**Finalize Case Status**
Single convergence point for every path (served / approved / denied / not-yet-eligible).
Derives one case_status field from whichever branch fired.
Avoids duplicating the same status logic three times downstream.

**Update Case Record**
Upserts the case state (attempt count, SOL countdown, status) — the state next run's escalation check reads.
Key: case_number.
This is the primary storage sink: the paralegal's live case tracker.

nodes.name: Note: Is Case Ready to Close?

parameters.content:
**Is Case Ready to Close?**
Branch point 3: only served / alt-service-authorized cases get an affidavit drafted.
Condition: case_status != 'attempts_continuing'.
Drafting affidavits for still-open cases would just create noise.

nodes.name: Note: Generate Affidavit of Service Draft

parameters.content:
**Generate Affidavit of Service Draft**
Fills a deterministic affidavit template from case data — a legal document should not hallucinate.
Output: affidavit_text, affidavit_filename.
The court needs an exact, auditable record, not an AI paraphrase.

**Save Affidavit to Drive**
Stores the signed-ready affidavit draft as the durable document artifact.
Folder: CASE_AFFIDAVITS_FOLDER_ID.
Gives the attorney a file to physically sign and file with the court.

nodes.name: Note: Submit to Court E-Filing API

parameters.content:
**Submit to Court E-Filing API**
Stages the affidavit as a draft filing in the court's e-filing queue.
Endpoint: /api/filings, status=draft_ready_for_review.
Staged, not final — a human attorney still has to review and sign before it's actually filed.

**Merge Case Outcome**
Reconverges the closed (affidavit-filed) path with the still-open path before the final status post.
Mode: append, 2 inputs.
Every attempt gets a status update regardless of whether the case closed.

**Post Case Status Update**
Posts a one-line status update to the team's case-tracking channel after every attempt.
Channel: #case-tracking.
Keeps the whole team current without anyone opening the case tracker.
